en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large fortified complex on a riverside hill. A long rectangular building with many small windows sits on top of a high stone wall. Rising behind it is a tall Baroque-style church tower with an onion-shaped dome and slender spire. Trees and landscaped slopes descend toward a calm river in the foreground, with a small decorative wooden footbridge near the water. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
